# FACHS

> FACHS is an adaptive fitness platform with an AI-assisted workout planner that builds training sessions around a person's available gym equipment, goals, workout split, training history, and available time.

FACHS helps people plan workouts using the equipment they can actually access. It also provides exercise alternatives, workout logging and history, and nutrition and food-discovery tools where supporting providers are available.

## Main pages

- [FACHS homepage](https://adaptive-fit-web.onrender.com/): Overview of the product, equipment-aware workout planning, features, and how to get started.
- [Help Center](https://adaptive-fit-web.onrender.com/help): Product guidance for workouts, equipment scanning, nutrition, gym discovery, and account access.
- [Terms of Use](https://adaptive-fit-web.onrender.com/terms): Terms governing use of FACHS.
- [Privacy Policy](https://adaptive-fit-web.onrender.com/privacy): Information about data used by FACHS and its product features.

## Key capabilities

- Equipment-based workout planning: create sessions based on available machines, weights, and other equipment.
- Adaptive workout planning: account for goals, training level, workout split, session duration, and workout history.
- Exercise alternatives: find substitute exercises with similar movement intent and target muscles.
- Workout tracking: record training and review workout history.
- Nutrition tools: use meal-planning and food-discovery features when the relevant data providers are available.

## Important notes

- FACHS is a fitness planning and information tool, not a medical service.
- Equipment recognition, nearby food discovery, and other provider-dependent features may vary in availability.
- Nutrition values and restaurant/menu details may be estimates or incomplete; users should verify important details with the provider.
